newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek shares fall despite easing interbank rates.
newsitem.headline: Greek shares fall despite easing interbank rates.

text.p: Greek equities were down sharply in mid-session on interest rates jitters related to a softer drachma although the picture in the interbank market had improved with rates easing from Thursday's levels.
The bourse's benchmark index was down 2.60 percent at 1,639.13 from Thursday's close of 1,682.88 with shares registering losses across the board.
